summary: Improve executive support, records control, and workflow follow-through with applied administrative tools. Review the course outline.
lede: Advanced administrative practice helps experienced support staff keep requests, records and follow-through under control. For executive assistants, administrative supervisors and office coordinators, the course applies workflow mapping and handoff analysis to everyday service work. Participants practise classifying and retrieving records, prioritizing requests, preparing concise decision briefs, and tracking meeting actions and service measures, with templates and an improvement plan to adapt.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already coordinate administrative work and now need stronger control over records, executive requests, and cross-team follow-through.
prerequisites: Prior experience in an administrative, executive-support, office-coordination, or records role is recommended. You should be comfortable using standard office applications and working with routine business records. No coding or programming is required.
